mapper.select: SELECT br.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS collected_at, br.property_id, br.data_source FROM building_registry br WHERE br.property_id = #{propertyId}

SELECT oh.is_current AS is_active, oh.registration_cause AS cause, oh.ownership_date AS received_date, oh.owner_name AS holder_name, oh.right_type, oh.rank_no FROM ownership_history oh JOIN building_registry br ON br.registry_id = oh.registry_id WHERE br.property_id = #{propertyId} ORDER BY oh.ownership_date ASC NULLS LAST, oh.rank_no ASC, oh.ownership_id ASC

SELECT mh.is_active, mh.receipt_date AS received_date, mh.max_bond_amount AS max_claim_amount, mh.mortgage_creditor AS creditor, mh.priority_no AS rank_no FROM mortgage_history mh JOIN building_registry br ON br.registry_id = mh.registry_id WHERE br.property_id = #{propertyId} ORDER BY mh.receipt_date ASC NULLS LAST, mh.priority_no ASC, mh.mortgage_id ASC
